regions.full_page: Rev. Fr. Kiniry and Fr. Solanus went to Mt. Hope with the Altar-boys where they played a good game of ball with their seniors 1-7. After lunch they took good swim and there played even harder than in the ball-campus-They did not sweat so much however! They also visited the Sisters Chapel and said the litany of St. Joseph. They: arrived home at the Monastery a little before 7("Disapointed")

regions.full_page: Feast of Assumption B.V.M. A.M. Services well attended, but not very many received. At Vespers not announced, four good servers at least were present L. Schaefer, A. Ahearn, J. Fitzpatrick, G. Gorman.

regions.full_page: Rev. Fr. Ignatius O.M.Cap. assembled the F.F and BB. of N. Y. for their annual retreat to conclude Aug. 24th & 3 pt During 1st week Rev. Fr. Bonavent. went to Our Lady of Angels' Church in Harlem. Fr. Solanus - to our Lady of . Sorrows - Pitt St. During these two weeks the Minor Ser- vers (Altar boys) gave considerable Edification, though there were some remarks made that they received Holy Com. rather seldom.
